The engineering model go shall generate artifacts deterministically so that regeneration is reproducible.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve the subsystem references declared by the parent system from local subdirectory paths.
Where system composition is enabled, if subsystem reference resolves outside repository workspace boundary, then the engineering model go shall reject the subsystem reference.
Where system composition is enabled, if subsystem reference graph contains a cycle, then the engineering model go shall reject the subsystem reference graph.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve cross-system references using subsystem-qualified identifiers.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall materialize parent-to-subsystem allocation traceability in the composed output without modifying any subsystem model.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall report each subsystem required interface that the parent system does not satisfy.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject an allocation that targets a subsystem identifier not published in the subsystem contract.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall flag any requirement that links to another requirement in the same document.
Where hardware interfaces are authored, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall render the hardware to software interface allocation view.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall produce a system requirement allocation matrix aggregated across the composed subsystems.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall render in the requirement view the delegation link from each delegated requirement to the specific subsystem requirement that satisfies it.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve an external git subsystem reference by cloning the repository into the workspace .engmod cache.
If code trace link names no model target, then the engineering model go shall reject the code trace link.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall flag each requirement that is traced by neither code nor verification nor a downward delegation.

When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall export a machine-readable traceability matrix that links each requirement to its implementing code plus verification plus delegated subsystem requirement.
When requirements delta is received, the engineering model go shall strictly validate requirements delta schema plus stable identifier operation uniqueness.
While dry run mode is active, when requirements delta is received, the engineering model go shall validate candidate architecture model without modifying requirements document.

requirements.text: When requirements delta is received, the engineering model go shall produce deterministic requirements change summary.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall normalize architecture model plus requirements document into canonical semantic model.
Where sysml export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate sysml v2 model artifact from canonical semantic model.
While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall validate sysml v2 model artifact before artifact generated event is raised.
Where sysml export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall validate canonical semantic model against sysml v2 metamodel.
While ci validation mode is active, if sysml v2 metamodel coverage is incomplete, then the engineering model go shall fail validation.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall preserve the deterministic native sysml v2 source through project interchange round trip.

Where naf profile authoring is enabled, when model check is requested, the engineering model go shall validate naf v4.1 stakeholder plus concern plus viewpoint metadata against canonical model references.
Where naf export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate deterministic naf v4.1 architecture document from referenced canonical model views.

While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject unsupported naf version plus unknown viewpoint code plus dangling profile reference before artifact generated event is raised.

When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall load schema version 2 engmod manifest plus catalog plus requirements plus architecture plus behavior plus assurance plus compliance plus views plus decisions documents into one canonical semantic model.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received and catalog references resolve successfully, the engineering model go shall return schema version 2 model authoring contract.

While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject model input that violates the schema version 2 manifest or any referenced domain document contract before artifact generated event is raised.

requirements.text: Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve each exact CUE module version from the OCI registry configured by CUE_REGISTRY.

Where a model workspace replacement is declared, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve the matching manifest dependency from the replacement repository without changing module identity or selected publications.

While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject invalid manifest dependency plus publication plus workspace replacement plus qualified reference declarations.

When example validation is requested, the engineering model go shall validate a schema version 2 company portfolio composed from multiple product systems that reuse published hardware plus software plus security plus compliance facets across repository boundaries.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall import only explicitly selected dependency publications with qualified identity plus source provenance.

Where six-view example output is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate deterministic use-case plus logical plus process plus physical plus implementation plus deployment view artifacts plus native SysML from one schema version 2 YAML bundle.

Where do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled, when model check is requested, the engineering model go shall load a strict aviation assurance profile plus lifecycle data plus verification evidence plus configuration baselines plus tool assessments plus structural coverage summaries.

Where do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject incomplete or inconsistent requirement classification plus derived requirement disposition plus verification chain plus independence plus baseline plus structural coverage plus tool assessment evidence.

Where do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate deterministic draft lifecycle data index plus objective evidence matrix plus requirements trace matrix plus verification summary plus structural coverage summary plus tool assessment register plus configuration index plus open gap report plus software accomplishment summary.

When example validation is requested, the engineering model go shall validate a schema version 2 DAL C flight control software example with placeholder planning plus requirements plus design plus code plus verification plus coverage plus configuration plus quality assurance plus certification liaison evidence.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall derive the default code scan root from the enclosing module boundary.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall assign path-derived CODE identifiers to every in-scope file with its declarations.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve authored references to CODE identifiers against the in-scope module files.
If referenced element uri addresses a local path, then the engineering model go shall reject the referenced element.
The engineering model go shall count a requirement as tested only through test entry points.
Where gemara export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall derive each gemara enforcement disposition plus policy risk treatment from the model status.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall select the model workspace from the ENGMOD_WORK setting.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall write or check the composition lock according to the lock mode.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall validate each qualified reference against the published entities of the selected dependencies.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall return the composition diagnostics with the generation result.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall show the trace status of each delegated requirement in its target repository.
When workspace sync is requested, the engineering model go shall write a local workspace that replaces only changed or pinned checkouts.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall return authoring assistance for an edited model document.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall warn about every unconnected behavior element.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall warn at each catalog term whose name contains an EARS expression operator.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report a multiple-response lint only for a requirement with more than one response action.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall warn about each control verification status that lags its existing tests.
When workspace staging is requested, the engineering model go shall publish every workspace checkout into the local staging area in dependency order.
When spec delta is requested, the engineering model go shall render OpenSpec spec delta text from the selected model requirements.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each assurance record whose verification links disagree.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall warn at each control that the gemara evaluation log would mark for review.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall infer implementation coverage from trace markers in comments of build and documentation artifacts.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each accepted assurance record that lacks an owner acceptance record.
When workspace sync is requested, the engineering model go shall write a go workspace replace directive for each required version of a workspace go module.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall return the allowed fields of each entity kind with the model authoring contract.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each requirement whose linked tests are all environment gated.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall return mcp tool result from the module model files on disk at call time.

requirements.text: When contract diff is requested, the engineering model go shall classify each contract item change between two git refs with its semantic version impact.
When release check is requested, the engineering model go shall reject a release that pins an unreleased dependency or whose tag bump is smaller than its contract diff requires.
When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall convert each deprecated allocation or contract ref into the requirement link model.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall report the parents and children of each requirement and roll each linked system requirement up from its realizing child requirements.

While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall return the requirement links of the loaded model with their state and the trace of each requirement through them.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall render the requirement link tree of a using model and the contract items of a child model without disclosing the users of the child.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall ignore each workspace entry that leaves the workspace plus each workspace entry that another user could have written.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall report each requirement link whose recorded fingerprint uses another canonical form than the engineering model go writes.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall render requirement link plus contract item text without AsciiDoc passthrough.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each accepted requirement link without a resolving reviewer plus review date.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each requirement link to a capability without a parent requirement.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall write an edit of one model entity only when the edited model is valid.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall scan the same code scope as the model check.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall return the type of every authorable field with the authoring rules.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall warn at each acceptance record that names a decision without the owner's statement.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall warn at each assurance record whose scoring or control trace disagrees with the rest of the model.
When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall warn at each requirement link that records a deprecated fingerprint.
When link add is requested, the engineering model go shall write a claimed requirement link with its parent, child and a pin at the dependency version.

requirements.text: While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall answer a model-reading tool for the family member checkout its repo argument names.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall warn at each requirement with quantitative verification criteria that only benchmarks verify.
When status suggestion is requested, the engineering model go shall print the status each requirement plus control verification earns from the evidence of the tree.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall name the term plus the catalog section of each unknown term in a requirement expression.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report a life-cycle tier decision that disagrees with the manifest lifecycle.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each tier-keyed diagnostic with the severity of the project tier.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report a composed dependency whose life-cycle tier is below or unknown to the tier of the system.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall apply strict requirement links from life-cycle tier mvp.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each requirement whose status or verification falls short of the life-cycle tier.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report a diagnostic that an open POA&M item of the project tier defers as a deferred warning naming the item.
If errors are raised only by the life-cycle tier, then the engineering model go shall render the document.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall return the severity of each tier-keyed code per life-cycle tier in the authoring contract.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each aviation evidence record below the evidence floor of the life-cycle tier.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each aviation assurance record that names an AI agent as the person holding the credit.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall return what a target life-cycle tier requires that the model does not meet.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall load each machine authored in a behavior document with its variables, states, initial state, final states, transitions and invariants.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall parse each machine expression text into a structured expression that records the position of any syntax error.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall project each loaded machine into elements of the canonical semantic model.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall validate each machine against the machine rules.
If behavior state is free-floating, then the engineering model go shall reject the state with a diagnostic that names the machines block.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each advisory machine diagnostic with the severity of the project life-cycle tier.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate one deterministic Quint module for each machine.

When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate Quint modules with engquint generate and check them with engquint check, exiting 0 on pass, 1 on a violation, a stale or drifted module or a vacuous trace and 2 on a setup error.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall run Quint on the TypeScript backend once for each invariant.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall verify each machine in verify mode against a pre-provisioned pinned Apalache without a download at run time.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall record each Quint result with the sha256 of its module so that a stale result is no evidence.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall count a passing non-stale formal result as analysis evidence for the linked requirement in the trace matrix.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall write a requirement-keyed formal entry for each Quint result into the Gemara evaluation log.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall report requirement-level formal results in the verification tools.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall keep the generated Quint modules with the other generated artifacts and report any drift in the artifact freshness gate.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall report code health smells for each function of Go, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript and Python source files.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall compute an explainable code health score from 1.0 to 10.0 for each source file.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall roll up file code health scores along the traceability of the model.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall validate the manifest health block including exclude, thresholds, overrides and waivers.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall require each code health waiver to cite an existing accepted decision.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report code health findings in enghealth reports with the severity of the project life-cycle tier.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall classify each code health finding against a base revision of the working tree.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall write the code health report in the neutral format engmod-health/1.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall run code health analysis with enghealth scan, check and baseline, exiting 0 when ok, 1 on blocking findings and 2 on a setup error.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall cache the code health result of each file by content hash and produce deterministic output.
The engineering model go shall produce byte-identical validation diagnostics plus generated documents for a model without a health block at the tiers below product.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall treat a finding listed in the committed health baseline as accepted debt.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report the error lifecycle.missing for a model without a lifecycle block.
If lifecycle block is incomplete, then the engineering model go shall report an error.
If required switch has a wrong value, then the engineering model go shall report an error.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report health.block_missing at the tiers product plus operational for a manifest without a health block.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report model.unsupported_schema_version with a remedy for a missing or unsupported schemaVersion.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report model.id_missing for an empty model identifier.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall print the remedy of a required-switch diagnostic and carry it in the structured output.
The engineering model go shall keep a remedy for every required-switch code in one table that an inventory test compares with the codes in both directions.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report a source file whose owner unit marker is missing or names no functional unit.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report a model link marker that names a requirement or a catalog term instead of a model element.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report an event-driven or state-driven requirement that no machine invariant or applies-to element models.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report a machine without an invariant and an invariant without a current formal result.
The engineering model go shall keep every model link marker stacked above one declaration.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each functional unit plus machine plus software interface that no source code names.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall accept a recorded exemption for a model element that is deliberately not implemented in this repository.
The engineering model go shall accept a list of requirements on every machine state, transition and event.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report each machine state plus transition plus event that lists no requirement.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report a composition lock whose schema version is not the current one.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report a repository check template that cannot take the workspace root instead of checking the repository with the library.
When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report an engine pin of a repository that is older than the engine that checks it.
The engineering model go shall provide one name for every argument of every tool and command.

When model check is requested, the engineering model go shall report a dependency without a declared tier as an error and report an incomplete aviation assessment and an unreferenced catalog term by tier.
If model declares a removed field, then the engineering model go shall reject the removed field with an error that names the remedy.
If requirements apply is unsafe, then the engineering model go shall refuse to write the requirements document.
